text:
mina: Heads-up: release CI failed because typegen produced a changelog reorder and semver check blocked publish.
oz: Ugh. Same flaky ordering vector we hit a few months back. Any quick root cause?
mina: suspect map iteration order from openapi->notes plugin after 3rd-party bump.
ci-bot: job 5073 failed: typegen-regendiff (see /ci/5073).
dev-tools: short mitigation: add a deterministic sort step in codegen templates; also strip generated meta before comparators.
nora: can we make the semver-checker tolerant to reorders? maybe canonicalize sections first and only block on content changes.
mina: I'll open a tiny PR to enforce sort by `section_id` then `published_at`.
oz: Also add a unit test that runs regen twice and asserts no diff. Helps catch regressions.
ci-bot: build 5074 started.
ci-bot: build 5074 failed: missed a `generated_at` timestamp still present.
mina: patched comparator to drop known meta keys. Pushed fix.
ci-bot: build 5075 started.
ci-bot: build 5075 succeeded: typegen-regendiff OK.
nora: nice. I suggest a pre-commit hook and a short line in the DX checklist about running `make regen`.
mina: added checklist note in PR and will merge after a quick review. :thumbsup:
oz: thanks all — saved a release window.
